info.name: Mirror Node REST accounts airdrops API
Get outstanding token airdrops sent by an account

params.name: idOrAliasOrEvmAddress
params.description: Account alias or account id or evm address

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return

params.name: order
params.description: The order in which items are listed

params.name: receiver.id
params.description: The ID of the receiver to return information for

params.name: serialnumber
params.description: The nft serial number (64 bit type). Requires a tokenId value also be populated.

params.name: token.id
params.description: The ID of the token to return information for

items.docs: Returns outstanding token airdrops that have been sent by an account.
